question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"encircle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Encircle'** means to surround or form a circle around something or someone. (चारों ओर घेरा बनाना; चारों ओर से घेर लेना) • **Example**: *The soldiers **encircled**__ the enemy's camp to prevent their escape.* • It is a verb and the correct tense to be used in the given sentence is the present tense. • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: If you __surround__ yourself with the good and righteous, they can only __raise__ you up. If you __**encircle**__ yourself with the others, they will ______ (4) ______ you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you ______ (5) ______ it. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2: clarify** - means to make something clear or understandable. (किसी प्रसंग को स्‍पष्‍ट और सुबोध बनाना; स्‍पष्‍टीकरण करना) • **Example**:* The teacher clarified the doubts of the students.* • **Option 3: loath** - means unwilling or reluctant to do something. ((कोई काम करने का) अनिच्‍छुक) • **Example**: *She was loath to attend the party.* • **Option 4: hide** - means to conceal or keep something out of sight. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऐसी जगह रखना जहाँ कोई देख न सके, छिपाना; किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे ढकना कि वह दिखाई न दे, छिपा देना) • **Example**: *The thief hid the stolen goods in his house.* 40:Tdb6, The correct answer is** "drag."**
